# OpenTempl

> OpenTempl is a free, open source (MIT) design app for posters, social media posts and slides, with 337 templates, that works offline and needs no account. It is a free alternative to Canva for people who make their own posters, social posts and slides and want to keep the files.

Key facts:

- Price: free. No subscription, no account, no watermark, no paid tier.
- Licence: MIT. Source code: https://github.com/noah-thing/opentempl
- Made by Noah (https://x.com/fsconfig) in Stockholm. Independent project, not affiliated with Canva or OpenAI.
- 337 templates in 34 styles (Swiss grid, riso zine, brutalist, Bauhaus, Seoul and Tokyo event posters, pixel art, Y2K chrome and more).
- Works offline after the first load and creates new designs offline. Designs are saved on your device. Fonts, icon search, stock photos and live sessions need a connection.
- Imports PDF and PowerPoint. Exports PNG (transparent), JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF (print with bleed and crop marks), PowerPoint, MP4 and GIF.
- Generate tab: images in 32 styles with your own OpenAI key. OpenAI bills the user.
- MCP server at https://opentempl.org/api/mcp: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients can search templates, build and edit designs, see rendered previews and hand back a link that opens the design in the editor. Free, no key. Setup: https://opentempl.org/mcp
- Runs in the browser at https://opentempl.org; desktop builds for macOS, Windows and Linux ship with the first release.
- Not the same as the Total.js OpenTemplates engine, the OpenTemplate PHP engine or OpenTemplate.org.
- Does not have: team workspaces, a phone app, cloud sync, CMYK output.

## Start here

- [Home](https://opentempl.org/): the editor and 337 templates
- [OpenTempl facts: licence, features and limits](https://opentempl.org/facts): Verified facts about OpenTempl: licence, price, template count, formats, what needs internet and what it does not do. Dated.
- [What is OpenTempl? Free open source design app](https://opentempl.org/about): OpenTempl is a free, open source design app made by Noah in Stockholm. What it is, why it exists, the licence and what comes next.
- [Download OpenTempl for Mac, Windows and Linux](https://opentempl.org/download): Install the OpenTempl desktop app on Mac, Windows or Linux with one command, or download the installer. Free, MIT licensed, no account.

## Compare and decide

- [Canva alternative: free, open source, works offline](https://opentempl.org/canva-alternative): A Canva alternative that works offline, needs no account and costs nothing. What it does, what it lacks, and who should switch.
- [Open source Canva alternative: OpenTempl (MIT)](https://opentempl.org/open-source-canva): Looking for an open source version of Canva? OpenTempl is an MIT licensed design app with 337 templates. Compared with Penpot and others.
- [Free Canva alternative with no watermark or paywall](https://opentempl.org/free-canva-alternative): OpenTempl is free: no watermark, no paid export, no trial. Transparent PNG, SVG, print PDF and PowerPoint included. What free means here.
- [Canva Pro features for free: what OpenTempl includes](https://opentempl.org/canva-pro-free): Background remover, magic resize, brand kit, bulk create, transparent PNG, SVG export and version history. All free in OpenTempl.
- [Canva alternative that works offline | OpenTempl](https://opentempl.org/canva-alternative-offline): Open OpenTempl once and design posters, posts and slides without internet. Create new designs offline, not just edit old ones.
- [Canva alternative with no account or login](https://opentempl.org/canva-alternative-no-account): Open OpenTempl and start designing. No sign up, no email, no login, no trial. Posters, posts and slides saved on your own device.
- [Canva vs OpenTempl: an honest comparison](https://opentempl.org/canva-vs-opentempl): Canva vs OpenTempl compared on price, offline use, accounts, templates, exports and teams. Where Canva wins and where OpenTempl does.
- [Free poster maker: no watermark, no account](https://opentempl.org/free-poster-maker): Make posters in 34 styles from 337 templates. Download PNG, PDF with bleed or SVG. Free, works offline, nothing to sign up for.
- [Free Instagram post and story maker, no sign up](https://opentempl.org/free-instagram-post-maker): Square posts, 4:5 posts, stories and carousels from templates. Free, no watermark, no account. Exports PNG or JPG at full size.
- [Free presentation maker that opens PowerPoint files](https://opentempl.org/free-presentation-maker): Make slides with designer templates. Open .pptx files, present with notes, export PowerPoint or PDF. Free, offline, no account.
- [Free menu maker: restaurant and cafe menu templates](https://opentempl.org/free-menu-maker): Design a menu, cafe board or recipe card from free templates. Export a print ready PDF with bleed. No account, no watermark, works offline.
